name: get_metadata_sfodata
description:
Get metadata of the OData service with optional filtering to reduce token consumption.
Returns the metadata in XML format, which can be used to discover available entities and their properties.
Call this endpoint every time before you call other tools to ensure understanding of the schema.
Based on the metadata, you can dynamically create an OData request.

Use filtering parameters to get specific metadata sections. Without parameters, this tool returns the complete XML metadata (which might be huge).
Only use the specified enum values for the filtering parameters.

name: batch_for_sfodata
description: Execute multiple OData operations in a single batch request using the $batch endpoint.

name: list_employeetime_for_sfodata
description: Retrieve employee time-off/leave records from SuccessFactors. Filter by userId and date range to check for approved leave conflicts with project timelines.

name: get_employeetime_for_sfodata
description: Retrieve a single EmployeeTime record by its external code.

name: count_employeetime_for_sfodata
description: Get the total count of EmployeeTime records matching a filter.
